decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several potential options including the HIKPRO and ZOMAKE packable daypacks which offer great value, and the High Sierra 70L for serious hiking. However, the shopping experience was marred by a highly irrelevant product feed. Nearly half of the search results for 'Backpacks' were non-backpack items like camping chairs, towels, blankets, and even a paddleboard. This lack of relevant variety and the presence of low-quality reviews on some of the more expensive items (like the USGI Alice pack) led me to conclude that this specific selection did not meet my needs. I'll continue my search on a different platform with better filtering.
